title: european investment bank loans elia 1 billion for princess elisabeth energy 2026 09 07
text:
BRUSSELS, Sept 7 (Reuters) - Belgian electricity transmission grid operator Elia (ELI.BR)
, opens new tab
 has secured a €1 billion ($1.2 billion) credit facility ​from the European Investment Bank for its ‌Princess Elisabeth island energy project in the North Sea, the organisations jointly confirmed on Monday.
The artificial island, which will be ​located 45 kilometres off the Belgian ​coast, is a flagship project for Elia ⁠and will serve as a large piece ​of offshore electricity grid infrastructure, connecting future offshore wind ​farms to the Belgian power grid.
The EIB said the €1 billion loan was the largest it had ever made for an ​energy infrastructure project in the Benelux region.
"The ​Princess Elisabeth Island is a strategic project that will ‌help ⁠unlock the next generation of offshore wind capacity, strengthen energy security and support Europe's competitiveness," said Elia Transmission Belgium's CEO ​Frédéric Dunon in ​a ⁠statement.
"The support of the European Investment Bank is a strong endorsement ​of the project's long-term value and ​of ⁠the shared ambition to build a more sustainable, resilient and affordable energy system for ⁠Belgium ​and Europe," added Dunon.
Elia ​reported higher first-half revenues in July and reiterated its full-year profit outlook.
($1 = 0.8614 ​euros)
